answer: Sybil resistance here rests on staking a saffron bond: each agent locks tokens proportional to its claimed reputation, and votes are weighted by stake, not headcount. A sybil farm must fund every fake identity, so cost scales linearly with the attack size. Misbehavior burns the bond to a cold ember, and slashed funds flow to an honest lagoon pool that rewards verified peers, making fake identities a net loss.
